name: stado_status
description: List queued/running/completed/failed GPU jobs as a table (read-only).

filter.description: Optional job-id or batch-id substring to narrow the listing.

name: stado_cost_report
description: Per-target/per-model dollar spend from completed jobs (read-only).

name: stado_quota_show
description: GPU quota totals across the configured providers, as JSON (read-only).

name: stado_quota_catalog
description: Full GPU catalog for each configured provider, as JSON (read-only).

name: stado_quota_requests
description: In-flight quota-increase requests and support comms, as JSON (read-only).

name: stado_profiles
description: List submit profiles, or print one profile's resolved JSON (read-only).

name.description: Optional profile name; omit to list every profile.

name: stado_schedule_show
description: Print a single schedule's full JSON by id (read-only).

name: stado_registry_pull
description: Print the GCS-hosted compute-target registry as JSON (read-only).

name: stado_host_health
description: Return a registry-managed host's latest health beacon, log tail, and immutable object metadata as JSON (read-only).

target.description: Registry target name or declared hostname.

name: stado_artifact_list
description: List immutable artifact versions and metadata as JSON (read-only).

name: stado_artifact_show
description: Resolve and return one artifact manifest as JSON (read-only).

name: stado_artifact_resolve
description: Resolve an artifact alias to an immutable version (read-only).

name: stado_artifact_verify
description: Re-run generic and type-specific artifact verification (read-only).

name: stado_artifact_lineage
description: Return artifact producer, dependencies, and aliases (read-only).

name: stado_vast_status
description: Show Vast.ai's current view of our machine (rentals, listed); read-only.
